summary: Down 0.2 from w15 (8.5). The rougher-to-glossier plastics help: shell top rims and arm caps now carry thin highlights like py_37301 / 37303, and at cabin distance (q13) the shell-to-fabric seams add outline darks that the photos have. But three of the new 'joint' parts are artefacts at the photo framings. (1) The cushion side strips (gRBox 0.012x0.012x0.46 at y 0.468) sit ON the cushion's side crown as black rods. Their rounded ends poke out past the cushion nose (p5 zoom), and on the window seat's outer side they float with nothing beside them (p8, p9). py_37301 has no such line, and its window-side cushion edge is open and light. (2) The cushion-front strip at y 0.377 is a hard 4 px line at L 8-15. In py_37301 the same crease is a soft 15-20 px shadow band at L 50-90. Before, a bright piping line was there, which was also wrong. (3) The shell shadow joint is right at q13, but in close views (q14 foreground) it renders as a 13 px pure-black slot (L 10-24) between two highlighted shell lips. In py_37303 (closest analogue) and san_13 the fabric meets the shell with only a soft 60-80 L shadow. Note: the round's after/p1_py2_front.png is a broken render (cabin corridor). My re-render of p1 from the candidate is fine.
lighting_note: Not scored. The q13 / q14 after renders show stronger rim speculars on the shells, which matches the photos. The window-side seats still read flat-lit compared with py_37302.
